clippings.speaker: Song Kang-ho
clippings.quote: When I first heard of 'Thirst,' I was doubtful whether or not such a creative, fantastic and artistic movie could be realized.
clippings.title: Park Chan-wook Explores Self, Dream in Thirst
clippings.context: Song reacting to Park's pitch of Thirst, in a March 2009 Korea Times feature ahead of the film's release.

clippings.speaker: Song Kang-ho
clippings.quote: I knew right away that he could bring the script to life.
clippings.title: 'Joint Security Area' cast and director reunite after 25 years
clippings.context: Song recalling why he agreed to Joint Security Area after first doubting the script, at the February 2025 anniversary reunion in Seoul.

clippings.speaker: Song Kang-ho
clippings.quote: That's the genius of Park Chan-wook: He was able to show us a solution.
clippings.title: 'Parasite' Star Song Kang-ho Reflects on 'Mr. Vengeance,' 'Memories of Murder,' and the Role of His Life
clippings.context: Song on how Joint Security Area handled the pressure of its box-office success, in a David Ehrlich interview for IndieWire during the Parasite press cycle.

clippings.speaker: Park Chan-wook
clippings.quote: Song Kang-ho didn't like either of them. But he ended up doing both.
clippings.title: A Conversation With Thirst Director Park Chan-wook
clippings.context: Park recalling how he pitched Thirst and Sympathy for Mr. Vengeance to Song over drinks after Joint Security Area wrapped, in a July 2009 Village Voice interview.

notes: Two of the three Song quotes come from fetched syndications or retrospectives, and the Park-about-Song direction is thin: IndieLondon's undated Park praise ("his acting is always very minimal") was skipped for lack of a date, and Backstage, AllKPop and Filmmaker returned 403s.
